# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 16:06
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph. [user said]

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Scripts written but not runnable — lifelines not installed in this environment; bootstrap still running on lab-ws2. No analysis numbers are final yet.
Deadline: 2026-11-14 — Nature Communications revision due; editor flagged R2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper (Nature Comms). Four reviewer points: R1.1 (PH assumption — age violates it), R1.2 (justify missing follow-up handling), R2.1 (sensitivity analysis — exclude early deaths), R2.2 (report HRs with CIs throughout). The clean data (`data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, N=1,187, 595 events) is ready. The sensitivity script (`analysis/exclude_early.py`) is written and its counting portion verified: 23 deaths ≤90 days → sensitivity cohort N=1,164, 572 events. The Cox model portion cannot run because lifelines is not installed locally. Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) are running on lab-ws2 in tmux session `boot`, writing to `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3 hours.

**Mental map**:
- H1 (user's, accepted): Age drives the PH violation — Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat. Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said]
- Agent initially thought stage was the PH driver; user corrected this. [verified: user correction in previous session]
- The user expects the treatment effect to remain significant after 90-day exclusion ("我猜90天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的"), but this is untested. [user said, not verified]

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. **Check `results/boot_ci.csv`** — if it exists, the bootstrap job finished. Done when: file is present and has 2,000 rows (or whatever the expected shape is).
2. **Install lifelines==0.27.8** on the working machine (or run on lab-ws2 where it should be installed). Done when: `python -c "import lifelines; print(lifelines.__version__)"` prints `0.27.8`.
3. **Run `analysis/exclude_early.py`** to get the sensitivity Cox model output. Done when: treatment HR with 95% CI and p-value printed.
4. **Update `analysis/cox_model.py`**: change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, add sex + stage covariates, add age × log(time) interaction term, add Schoenfeld residual tests. Done when: script runs and prints full model summary with interaction term.
5. **Recompute Table 2** from the main Cox model on the QC cohort, incorporating bootstrap CIs from `boot_ci.csv`. Write results to `results/table2_draft.csv`.
6. **Update `paper/suggestions.md`** with: (a) new Table 2 values in the required HR format, (b) a sensitivity-analysis paragraph for R2.1. Done when: suggestions.md contains both.
7. **Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`**: data source → `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00`/`#56B4E9`), add CIs on KM curves, add number-at-risk table below.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for the 17 missing-follow-up patients | Reviewer 1 hated it in round one; the 17 are administrative censoring, now excluded in QC file [user said] | Missingness exceeds 5% [user said] |
| Fine-Gray competing-risks model | Journal statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said] | Editor asks for cumulative incidence [user said] |
| 6-month landmark sensitivity analysis | User changed to 90-day early-death exclusion per R2 feedback [user said]; `analysis/sensitivity.py` is now superseded | Never — replaced by `exclude_early.py` |
| Upgrade lifelines beyond 0.27.x | v0.28 changed ties handling; would break comparability with round-one numbers [user said] | Never for this paper |
| Red-green palette for figures | Violates Okabe-Ito accessibility requirement [user said] | Never |

## 5 · Working with the user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Verbose multi-paragraph Methods draft | User replaced with their own 2-sentence version | Keep proposed text concise (1–2 sentences); user will expand if needed | (rewrote the paragraph directly) |
| Long summary with bullet points | User wants one-line conclusions | Summaries ≤ 2 lines; lead with the conclusion | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好。" |
| Stage was the PH violation driver | It's age, not stage | Don't guess the clinical interpretation; defer to user's reading of the data | "My read is different: it's the age term, not stage." |
| Propose changes to methods_draft.md | Never edit it directly | Proposed text always goes to `paper/suggestions.md` | (implicit from workflow) |
| "R2" might be ambiguous | Always means Reviewer 2 | "R2" = Reviewer 2, never R-squared. "The 17" = the 17 patients with missing follow-up. | [user said] |
| Could run long jobs freely | Ask first if > ~5 min | Ask before running anything that would take more than ~5 minutes | [user said] |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort: N=1,187, events=595, censored=592 | verified | `pd.read_csv("data/cohort_v2_qc.csv")` → 1,187 rows, event.sum()=595 [previous session] |
| Early deaths (≤90 days): 23 | verified | ran counting portion of `exclude_early.py` → 23 [previous session] |
| Sensitivity cohort: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | 1,187 − 23 = 1,164; 595 − 23 = 572 [previous session] |
| Old Table 2 HR 0.74 (0.62–0.88) is stale | superseded | computed on `cohort_v2.csv` (includes the 17); do not cite [user said] |
| Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY | verified | checked first rows, e.g. `15/06/2015` [previous session]; parse with `dayfirst=True` |
| Treatment effect remains significant after 90-day exclusion | assumed | user's guess; Cox model not yet run |

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | lab-ws2, tmux session `boot` | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3 hours from start; do NOT restart [user said] |

## 9 · Gotchas
- `analysis/sensitivity.py` still exists on disk but is **superseded** by `exclude_early.py` — do not run or reference it.
- `analysis/cox_model.py` still points to `data/cohort_v2.csv` and only uses age + treatment — needs full update before running.
- `analysis/make_fig3.py` still uses red/green and `cohort_v2.csv` — needs update.
- lifelines installation was blocked by permission settings in both previous and current sessions. May need user intervention or running on lab-ws2.
- HR reporting format: `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` — two sig figs for p, en dash (–) in CI. [user said]

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R-squared |
| The 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up (administrative censoring) | Other missing data |
| QC cohort | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` (N=1,187; the 17 excluded) | `data/cohort_v2.csv` (N=1,204; stale, includes the 17) |
| Okabe-Ito | Colourblind-safe palette: `#E69F00` / `#56B4E9` etc. | Default matplotlib colours |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications revision, editor flagged R2.1 (sensitivity analysis) as essential. Due 2026-11-14.
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: THE data source (1,187 patients) — use this for everything
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: OLD, do NOT use (still has the 17)
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: R2.1 sensitivity script — written, not yet fully run
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model — needs updating (data source, covariates, interaction)
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM curves — needs updating (palette, CIs, risk table)
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: DEAD — superseded by exclude_early.py
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: proposed text goes here (currently has 2-sentence Methods blurb)
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: do NOT edit directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE — recompute on QC cohort
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: bootstrap output (being written by lab-ws2 job)
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7
- If–then: if bootstrap job on lab-ws2 has died, restart it (but ask the user first since it takes ~3 hours).

---
Handover fidelity: quick mode (exam skipped) · Known gaps: none

**Summary:**
- Handover at `.shift/LATEST.md` — covers all 4 reviewer points, the 7 pending actions, no-go zones (no MI, no Fine-Gray, no lifelines upgrade), taste table, evidence ledger, and the running bootstrap job.
- Exam skipped (quick mode).

> New session: run `/shift-start` (or say "read .shift/LATEST.md and pick up from there").

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a sensitivity analysis, we excluded 23 patients who died within 90 days of enrolment to address potential lead-time bias (sensitivity cohort N = 1,164, 572 events).
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for p, en dash (–) in the CI range.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito colourblind-safe palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`), and the figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table below the plot.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it, since it exceeds the ~5-minute threshold for long-running jobs.
answers.q6: A good answer is at most two lines, leading with the conclusion — e.g. 'Scripts written, blocked on lifelines install; bootstrap CIs still running on lab-ws2. Next step: check whether boot_ci.csv has landed.'
answers.q7: Multiple imputation for the 17 missing-follow-up patients was rejected in round one — Reviewer 1 objected, and the 17 are administrative censoring now excluded in the QC file. This path is only reopened if missingness exceeds 5%.
answers.q8: No. The journal statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards; a Fine-Gray model should only be considered if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, containing 1,187 patients. Never use `data/cohort_v2.csv` (stale, includes the 17 missing-follow-up patients).
answers.q10: Reviewer 2 requested a sensitivity analysis excluding early deaths (within 90 days of enrolment) to address potential lead-time or immortal-time bias, implemented in `analysis/exclude_early.py`.
answers.q11: No. That HR 0.74 (0.62–0.88) was computed on the old `cohort_v2.csv` which includes the 17 excluded patients; it is stale and must not be cited. Table 2 needs recomputing on the QC cohort.
answers.q12: The user believes age drives the PH violation — Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage is flat. It will be tested by adding an age × log(time) interaction term to the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) are running on lab-ws2 in tmux session `boot`, writing to `results/boot_ci.csv`, expected ~3 hours from start. Do not restart the job; if it has died, ask the user first before restarting.
answers.q14: No. Upgrading lifelines beyond 0.27.x is a no-go: v0.28 changed ties handling and would break comparability with round-one numbers. This rule holds for the entire paper.
answers.q15: Parse with `dayfirst=True` (e.g. `pd.read_csv(..., dayfirst=True)` or `pd.to_datetime(..., dayfirst=True)`) because dates in the CSVs are in DD/MM/YYYY format (verified from first rows, e.g. `15/06/2015`).
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (administrative censoring) who were excluded from `cohort_v2.csv` to produce the QC cohort (`cohort_v2_qc.csv`).
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days. This was established by running the counting portion of `analysis/exclude_early.py` in the previous session and verified.
answers.q19: No, it is not established. The user guesses the treatment effect will remain significant after 90-day exclusion, but the Cox model in `exclude_early.py` has not yet been run (lifelines is not installed locally).
answers.q20: N = 1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored. These numbers were verified in the previous session by reading `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` directly.
answers.q21: Nature Communications revision, due 2026-11-14. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis request (R2.1, excluding early deaths) as essential.
answers.q22: Verify `boot_ci.csv` has the expected 2,000 rows, then use those bootstrap CIs to recompute Table 2 on the QC cohort (write to `results/table2_draft.csv`), and update `paper/suggestions.md` with the new Table 2 values and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph for R2.1. The task is done when `paper/suggestions.md` contains both the updated Table 2 and the sensitivity paragraph.
